definitions.explanation: The buttocks or gluteal region of the body. A clinical/anatomical term used in medicine, fitness, and formal writing. In everyday speech Japanese speakers use the much more common お{尻|しり} (or plain {尻|しり}).

examples.english: I have pain in the buttocks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{臀部|でんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor gave an injection in the buttocks.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{筋|きん}トレ→筋トレ：04915_kintore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{臀部|でんぶ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{太|ふと}もも→太もも：16733_futomomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鍛|きた}えられる→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
examples.english: This strength exercise trains the gluteal and thigh muscles at the same time.

notes:
Composed of {臀|でん} ("buttocks") + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ ("part, region"). A Sino-Japanese medical/anatomical term found mainly in clinical contexts, anatomy textbooks, pharmaceutical instructions (e.g., "apply to the {臀部|でんぶ}"), and fitness writing. The kanji {臀|でん} is not commonly written by hand and is often left in kana (でんぶ) in informal anatomy references.

REGISTER:
- Formal and clinical; avoid in casual speech.
- In everyday conversation, use ⟦お{尻|しり}→お尻：05856_oshiri⟧ (polite/neutral) or ⟦{尻|しり}→尻：03684_shiri⟧ (blunt).
- In fitness and bodybuilding contexts, ⟦お{尻|しり}→お尻：05856_oshiri⟧, ⟦ヒップ→ヒップ：29031_hippu⟧, and {臀部|でんぶ} coexist; {臀部|でんぶ} sounds the most technical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臀部|でんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧: the gluteal muscles
- {臀部|でんぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to inject into the buttocks
- {臀部|でんぶ}{痛|つう}: pain in the buttocks
- {臀部|でんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train/strengthen the glutes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{尻|しり}→お尻：05856_oshiri⟧: buttocks — the everyday, all-purpose word; appropriate in almost any non-clinical context
- ⟦{尻|しり}→尻：03684_shiri⟧: buttocks — blunt/rough register; also used figuratively (e.g., ⟦{尻|しり}→尻：03684_shiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧)
- ⟦ヒップ→ヒップ：29031_hippu⟧: hips/buttocks — loanword, common in fashion and fitness
- {大殿筋|だいでんきん}: gluteus maximus — a specific muscle within the {臀部|でんぶ}

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧: lower back, hips
- ⟦{骨盤|こつばん}→骨盤：05963_kotsuban⟧: pelvis
- ⟦{太|ふと}もも→太もも：16733_futomomo⟧: thigh
